Here's a side-by-side comparison of New York City and San Francisco weather:

| Metric | New York City | San Francisco |
|--------|--------------|---------------|
| Temperature | 22°C (72°F) | 18°C (64°F) |
| Condition | Partly Cloudy | Foggy |
| Humidity | 65% | 80% |
| Wind Speed | 15 km/h | 20 km/h |
| Air Quality | N/A | 42 (Good) |

New York City is warmer with clearer skies, while San Francisco has its characteristic fog with better air quality monitoring data available.
